direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 52px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; cols 184px rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage / 360px inspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before shrinking type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge stage labels under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; guide strip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge SVG machine and route labels to 11px minimum; the job and evidence labels are the hardest text to read at 1366x768.
Reduce inspector card height so the third evidence source is fully visible without relying on the thin scrollbar.
Align the 120 and 80 track ends and place DOES NOT MATCH on one shared baseline for faster comparison.
Keep ROUTE HEALTH - PRE-FLIGHT and INVESTIGATION - SOURCE EVIDENCE as separate labelled regions with independent status lines; visually strengthen the divider between them.
Add nonce and identity status rows inside pre-flight only, each with explicit pass, blocked or not-run text rather than route text alone.
Enlarge the offline route selector text and give it a 40px target with a visible focus ring.
Keep the typed consent form directly tied to the selected path and show the selected option, plan identifier and exact phrase on adjacent lines before the input.
Dim unselected option cards further so the single neon selected path is unmistakable.
Move the character count inside the input footer and retain Accept disabled until the exact phrase matches.
Refit the task list so t3 is not clipped at the inspector bottom; reduce card gaps before reducing type.
Prevent the accepted-plan callout in the SVG from overlapping RECOVERY FLOW text; shift the callout below the route.
Remove the duplicate Approve action emphasis by keeping one primary in the action bar and secondary styling for the inspector approve control.
Label CELL-MILL-2 in the stage as PREVIEW - WILL GO OFFLINE with dashed silver styling, reserving red until the shock is applied.
Make the invalidation consequence a single high-contrast status line directly above Apply second shock.
Enlarge the machine selector to a 40px target and pair its label with the selected value at all times.
Keep red, cross-hatch and STOPPED text only on CELL-MILL-2, and add OFFLINE-STOPPED to the persistent legend directly beneath the node.
Mark Split available capacity as CONSTRAINED with hatch plus text in both SVG and inspector summaries.
Strengthen the separation between pre-flight route health and the not-run investigation panel with distinct headings and status icons in text form.
Ensure the constrained Split card remains fully non-interactive, hatched and explained, while the selected feasible path retains the only neon outline.
Place PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED status in the inspector above the consent input, not only in the action bar.
Align finish and incremental cost columns across all three option cards on shared baselines.
Replace nested scrolling in the project board with one inspector scroll region so blocked prior tasks and proposed replacements can be compared without inner scroll traps.
Use separate headed groups: 3 BLOCKED prior tasks, then 3 PROPOSED replacements - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL, with the approved revised plan stated above both.
Refit the SVG accepted-plan callout to stop overlapping route labels around CELL-MILL-1.
Use one Verify ledger primary only; when verification is the current task, remove the duplicate primary from the action bar or restyle the inspector control as secondary.
Number the three retention stages with locked, enabled and waiting states in text, and keep the passphrase field disabled until ledger verification completes.
Correct the truncated VS REPLENISHMENT metric label by allowing the full label on one line at 11px.
Keep Recovery story complete out of the numbered 01-09 rail sequence or mark it as a distinct completion item with aria-current and a check plus text.
Retain the sealed status in the action bar centre and remove any forward primary so completion is unambiguous.
Show 18 EVENTS - PACKET SEALED beside the ledger chain and keep CELL-MILL-2 red stopped styling in the final state.
